szoveg_eredeti:
Bloomberg :

 New US chip export rules threaten SEA's data center boom, risking incomplete and abandoned projects and forcing neoclouds to replace their Chinese customers   —  Washington's new rulebook spells trouble for a multibillion dollar cloud business helping to power the region's data center boom.
